About

I work at the intersection of talent acquisition, people operations and business strategy. My focus is helping organisations identify professionals who can do the work, strengthen the culture and contribute to the bigger picture.

My experience spans technical and nontechnical recruitment, discreet search, distributed team hiring and people operations. I combine structured sourcing, behavioural assessment and project management principles to keep hiring focused and aligned with the needs of the business.

Across fintech, technology, education and oil and gas, I have built hiring around people and business goals, in teams spread across EMEA, APAC and LATAM.

Perspective

Founders, Co-Founders, CTOs, COOs and HR leaders all stay awake at night worrying about three things: People, Product and Profit.

Here is the reality: you cannot scale a great product or drive consistent profit without the right talent in place. That is where I come in.

I help high-growth companies solve their talent bottlenecks by sourcing, hiring and aligning top-tier professionals. By placing high-performing talent in critical roles, I help leadership teams build market-leading products and scale revenue predictably through targeted workforce positioning.

The cost of a bad hire is irrecoverable. Even if you recover the financial resources spent, you will never get back the time wasted.
